question: By what percentage was the lactic acid concentration higher in LPGood than in LPBad alfalfa silage?
rendered:
Document: Fermentation Quality Divergence of Alfalfa Silage within the Same Batch: Insights from 16S rRNA Sequencing and Untargeted Metabolomics, page 3

The lactic acid concentration was 11.27% in the LPGood group and 10.01% in the LPBad group. To find the percentage by which the lactic acid concentration was higher in LPGood than in LPBad, we can calculate:

((11.27 - 10.01) / 10.01) * 100% = 12.3%

Therefore, the lactic acid concentration was 12.3% higher in LPGood than in LPBad alfalfa silage.
